## Walgreens Boots Alliance — Fiscal Q3 Comparable Sales

The most recent reported figure is **FQ3 2025** (quarter ended May 31, 2025), WBA's final public quarter before the Sycamore Partners take-private deal closed.

### FQ3 FY2025 (quarter ended May 31, 2025)

**U.S. Retail Pharmacy segment:**
- Total segment sales: **$30.7B, +7.8% YoY**
- **Comparable pharmacy sales: +14.6%** (helped by branded-drug inflation and mix)
- **Comparable retail (front-end) sales: –2.4%** — weakness in grocery/household, health & wellness, and beauty
- Pharmacy sales +12%; retail sales –5.3% (includes footprint-optimization store closures)
- Comparable 30-day equivalent prescriptions filled: **+2.7%**; total scripts 308M, +0.4%
- Company-wide sales ~$39B, net loss $175M

### FQ3 FY2024 (quarter ended May 31, 2024) — for comparison
- U.S. Retail Pharmacy sales: **$28.5B, +2.3%**
- Pharmacy sales +4.4%, with comparable pharmacy sales growth (front-end/retail comps roughly flat-to-down)

**Key takeaway:** The comps story in FQ3 was driven almost entirely by **pharmacy — up ~14.6% on a comparable basis** — while the **front-end retail comp declined ~2.4%**, continuing the secular weakness in discretionary store sales.

Sources:
- FierceHealthcare, "Walgreens reports $39B in sales, $175M loss in fiscal Q3": https://www.fiercehealthcare.com/providers/walgreens-sales-rise-7-39b-driven-pharmacy-growth-cost-cutting-measures-take-private-deal

- WBA FQ3 2024 results (Businesswire): https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20240627386068/en/Walgreens-Boots-Alliance-Reports-Fiscal-2024-Third-Quarter-Results
- WBA press release index: https://investor.walgreensbootsalliance.com/news-releases/news-release-details/walgreens-boots-alliance-reports-fiscal-2025-third-quarter

Note: Because WBA is now private (Sycamore Partners), there may be no subsequent public quarterly comps. If you meant a different period (e.g., a specific CVS/Rite Aid comparison or an earlier WBA quarter), let me know and I'll pull it.
